runMeta.notes: Coupling mechanism audit comparing absolute-memory and difference-attractor coupling formulas with coupling-order variants.

auditFindings.previousFormula: Code audit found the existing implementation uses a difference-to-other-memory pull: fieldA += G * W * (fieldB.memory - fieldA.phi), and fieldB uses a per-cell snapshot of fieldB.phi plus fieldA.memory. It is not an absolute-memory add in the current repository.
auditFindings.previousOrder: diagnostic-surrogate-utils runs field dynamics, then EWMA memory update and memory blend, then applySelectedCoupling/applyMemoryCoupling. Phase rotation is not applied in this surrogate runner.
